description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow for changes to the design of the approved park landscaping of planning permission 00607/AM/P5, approved 19/05/2016, for the creation of 26 permanent moorings with a new 14 space car park and associated landscaping.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (New drawings to be added: Drawing 877-L-01(I) [Design Proposals], received 27/09/2021. Drawings 877-L-01 [Existing Site], 877-L-03, 877-L-04, 877-D-01, 877-D-02, 877-D-03, 877-D-04, 877-D-05, 877-D-06, received 24/09/2021. Location Plan, received 16/09/2021. Statement describing Design Changes, received 19/08/2021. Original drawings to be retained: Drawings 521560-A-055 Rev. PL3 [Existing Site Plan - Showing Moorings], 521560-A-056 Rev. PL3 [Proposed Site Plan], 521560-A-140 Rev. PL2 [L0 Car Park Plan], 521560-A-146 Rev. P1 [L1 Car Park Plan with Visibility Splays Shown], 521560-A-060 Rev. PL1 [Existing Longitudinal Site Section], 521560-A-221 Rev. PL1 [Proposed Sections A-A and B-B], 521560-A-300 Rev. PL1 [Proposed Elevations, South East, South West, North East] and 521560-A-057 Rev. PL2 [Existing Site Plan, Tree Removal Plan], Flood Risk Assessment by Frankham dated 28 May 2015 and Appendix Report to Flood Risk Assessment by Frankham dated November 2015, Existing and Proposed Sections and Elevations Sheet 1 Rev. PL1, Existing and Proposed Sections and Elevations Sheet 2 Rev. PL1, Ecological Improvements General Arrangement Rev. PL1, Ecological Improvements Sections and Details Rev. PL1, Proposed Layout of the Foul Drainage Rev. PL1, Section Through Proposed Steps Rev. PL1, Arboricultural Survey [Ref. PJC/3414/14], Navigational Risk Assessment by Frankham [Ref. 521560-FCG-C-NAVREPORT-FIN-VER1.0] and River Impact Assessment by HR Wallingford [Ref. DDM7742-RT001-R02-00]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the 'Details of Materials Waterman's Park, Planning Condition Report' received on 1st May 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(1-27).

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work on the River Thames shall take place during the bird breeding season for Heron (March - mid May) and none shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Fridays and 8am to 1pm on Saturdays, with the timing of piling works to coincide with either the middle of the day or during low tide.  No demolition or construction work shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the 'Waste Management Waterman's Park, Planning Condition Report' received on 26th April 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(1-27), with the refuse and recycling arrangements maintained permanently thereafter.

Condition : 5 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the 'Construction Environmental Management Plan Waterman's Park, Planning Condition Report' received on 26th April 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(1-27).

Condition : 6 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the 'Energy Strategy Waterman's Park, Planning Condition Report' received on 29th March 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(1-27).

Prior to first occupation of the development evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the National Calculation Method) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.

Condition : 7 - The development hereby approved shall be managed in full accordance with the 'Removal , Storage and Disposal of Liquid and Hazardous Wastes Waterman's Park, Planning Condition Report' received on 26th April 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(1-27).

Condition : 8 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the 'Archaeological Scheme of Written Investigation (WSI) Waterman's Park, Planning Condition Report' received on 23rd April 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(9-12).

Condition : 9 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the 'Bicycle Storage Waterman's Park, Planning Condition Report' received on 18th April 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(1-27), with the cycle parking facilities made available prior to first occupation of the moorings and maintained permanently thereafter.

Condition : 10 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the 'Car Park Waterman's Park, Planning Condition Report' received on 29th March 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(1-27), with the car parking facilities made available prior to first occupation of the moorings and maintained permanently thereafter.

Condition : 11 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the 'Road Safety Audit Waterman's Park, Planning Condition Report' received on 10th May 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(9-12), with access provided as per the approved details prior to first occupation of the moorings and maintained permanently thereafter.

Condition : 12 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the 'Operational Management Plan Waterman's Park, Planning Condition Report' received on 30th April 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(1-27). The moorings and associated infrastructure shall be operated at all times in accordance with the approved OMP.

Condition : 13 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the 'External Lighting Equipment Waterman's Park, Planning Condition Report' received on 30th April 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(1-27). The approved external lighting shall be installed prior to first use of the moorings and maintained permanently thereafter.

Condition : 14 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the 'Life Saving Equipment Waterman's Park, Planning Condition Report' received on 26th April 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(1-27). The approved life saving equipment shall be made available prior to first use of the moorings and maintained permanently thereafter.

Condition : 15 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the 'Construction Method Statement, Planning Condition Report' received on 29th March 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(1-27).

Condition : 16 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the details submitted in this application, listed as follows: Drawing 877-L-01(I) (Design Proposals, received on 27th September 2021, Drawings 877-L-03, 877-L-04, 877-D-01, 877-D-02, 877-D-03, 877-D-04, 877-D-05, 877-D-06 received on 24th September 2021 and 'Statement describing Design Changes' received on 19th August 2021. The scheme shall be implemented as approved prior to first use of the moorings.

Condition : 17 - In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, including the 'Retained Trees Waterman's Park, Planning Condition Report' received on 29th March 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(1-27). Paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of (5 years) from (the date of the occupation of the building for its permitted use).

(a)	No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local planning authority.  Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard [3998 (Tree Work)] or any other BS replacing it.
(b)	If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the local planning authority.
(c)	The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site.  Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.

Condition : 18 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the 'Arboricultural Method Statement, Planning Condition Report' received 29th March 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(1-27).

Condition : 19 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the 'Sustainable Drainage System Waterman's Park, Planning Condition Report' received on 30th April 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(20). Discharge shall be limited to the greenfield rate for the drained area @ 5.2 litres/sec.

Condition : 20 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the 'Construction Environmental Management Plan, Waterman's Park, Planning Condition Report' received on 2nd May 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(1-27).

Prior to commencement of any extensive earthworks or piling:
(a)	If required, a scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for written approval, with any necessary remediation to account for comments made by the Local Planning Authority prior to occupation of the development. 

During the course of the development:
(b)	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.  

Before the development is first brought into use:
(c)	The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses a) and b) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.

Condition : 21 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the 'Ecological Improvements (Reed Structure) Waterman's Park, Planning Condition Report' received on 29th March 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(1-27).

Condition : 22 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the 'Sound Survey Waterman's Park, Planning Condition Report' received on 18th April 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(1-27), and noise from any plant or utilities in the new building hereby approved shall not exceed 10dBA below the background noise level as measured at the nearest sensitive receptor (Victoria Steps Quays houseboats).

Condition : 23 - Prior to the construction of the development for the river moorings a comprehensive river wall survey, including, where required, intrusive investigative works of the existing river wall shall be undertaken to establish the following:

"	The location, landward extent & condition of the buried element of the defence.
"	The structural integrity and stability of the wall, including, if needed, intrusive investigation and or testing of the wall and any buried element. 
"	Works required to bring the defences up to the life expectancy of the development. 

A report detailing the findings of the survey shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. 

River wall works resulting from the scheme shall be fully implemented in accordance with the approved scheme prior to construction of the development for the river moorings.

Condition : 24 - Prior to the commencement of the proposed enabling works for the river moorings a Water Framework Directive (WFD) assessment covering the chemical risks associated with the proposed enabling works must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. All work must be carried out in accordance with the approved assessment.

Condition : 25 - Prior to the commencement of the construction works for the river moorings a Water Framework Directive (WFD) assessment covering the dredging/regrading activity must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. All work must be carried out in accordance with the approved assessment.

Condition : 26 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out in full accordance with the 'Scheme to Safeguard the Thames Path Waterman's Park, Planning Condition Report' received on 26th April 2019 and approved as part of application 00607/AM/P5(1-27).
